/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY' > clump_regions.txt
clumps=[17311190,172122601,218624533,53514728,103551918,168737147,41744821,149906413,176802766,118862669,89029331,184023529,227847233,223857726,20280633,9549328,46912162]
for pos in clumps:
    print(f'1:{max(1,pos-500000)}-{pos+500000}')
PY
cat clump_regions.txt"
